# CBD support

Use **Bug / reproducibility problem** for package, test, script, schema or benchmark execution failures.

Use **Scientific / model issue** for cognitive mechanism, evidence-level, calibration, synthetic recovery, validation or paradigm questions.

Before opening an issue, check [README.md](../README.md) and [STATUS.md](../STATUS.md).

Do not disclose sensitive vulnerability details in a public issue. A dedicated security policy is deferred until a private reporting route is configured.
